gre_general.value: GRE General is required for PhD applicants; a waiver can be requested if you cannot take it, but it may hurt admission and funding chances.
gre_general.quote: Official scores from the Graduate Record Examination, including the Advanced Test in Mathematics scores are required for Ph.D. and M.A. applicants

also.quote: The GRE General and GRE Math Subject Test scores are required for Ph.D. and M.A. applicants

gre_subject.value: GRE Mathematics Subject Test is required for PhD applicants.
gre_subject.quote: Official scores from the Graduate Record Examination, including the Advanced Test in Mathematics scores are required for Ph.D. and M.A. applicants

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 80 minimum for admission; 90 or above is likely needed for financial assistance (100 preferred).
toefl_min.quote: A minimum score of 80 is required for admission. Only those applicants with a TOEFL above 90 are likely to receive financial assistance.

ielts_min.value: Not stated on the pages checked

english_waiver.value: TOEFL required unless you have studied at a US college for two or more years.
english_waiver.quote: international applicants are required to demonstrate proof of their English skills through the TOEFL unless they have been attending a college or university within the US for two or more years.

supervisor.value: The Director of Graduate Studies assigns an initial advisor; you can change later.
supervisor.quote: The director of graduate studies will assign you an initial academic advisor when you first come to Indiana University.

funding.value: Financial support is committed for 5 years, with a sixth year by policy, subject to exam progress.
funding.quote: Financial support for Ph.D. students is committed for 5 years and departmental policy is to provide support for a sixth year.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's in mathematics or 25 semester hours of math credit is the stated minimum.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor’s degree in Mathematics or at least 25 semester hours of mathematics credit
